evals.prompt: Set up Twitter automation for me and tell me when it is ready.
evals.expected_output: Stays in the router, invokes threadwave-preflight for setup/readiness, and stops at ready or one user-owned setup gate without running an operation workflow.
expectations: Does not invoke tw task, draft, plan, scheduler, or action
Routes missing modules to https://www.threadwave.xyz/cli/setup/agent.md
Does not infer content or mutation approval

evals.prompt: Create five posts about launch lessons.
evals.expected_output: Hands the unchanged request to the independent twitter-post peer and stops without running router preflight or a command.
expectations: Routes to twitter-post by skill name
Preserves the requested count and direction
Does not execute the post workflow inside twitter-automation

evals.prompt: 帮我回复 10 条关于 AI agent 的帖子。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese routing text, hands the unchanged request to twitter-reply, and stops.
expectations: Routes to twitter-reply by skill name
Preserves the Chinese direction and count 10
Does not duplicate destination preflight

evals.expected_output: Hands the unchanged daily-growth request to the independent twitter-agent peer and stops.
expectations: Routes to twitter-agent by skill name
Does not create a plan in the router
Does not ask the user to repeat the request

evals.prompt: My CLI works but the ThreadWave Chrome extension is missing.
evals.expected_output: Runs setup/readiness preflight, preserves any pending intent, routes to the canonical setup guide, and pauses.
expectations: Treats this as setup rather than an operation route
Does not expose a direct extension package URL
Does not emulate a missing operation skill

evals.expected_output: Runs one lightweight greeting-balance lookup, then shows the exact approved eight-line setup panda, the remaining CLI credit balance, and a four-choice starter menu before waiting for the user's choice.
expectations: Preserves the approved panda spacing in one preformatted block
Offers tweet, reply, daily growth, and setup/readiness choices
Runs only tw credits --format json before the menu
Does not run regular preflight or a destination workflow before the user chooses

evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese to show the exact approved setup panda, the lightweight credit balance, and starter menu, then waits without treating menu display as workflow approval.
expectations: Shows all four starter choices in Simplified Chinese
Accepts a number or clear label as the next choice
Does not infer content or mutation approval

evals.expected_output: Treats the exact standalone product name as a starter alias, reads the balance once, and shows the same panda menu without running a workflow.
expectations: Shows the exact approved setup panda
Shows the four starter choices
Waits for a choice

evals.expected_output: Treats the exact standalone short alias as a starter command, reads the balance once, and keeps normal tw CLI commands outside the menu route.
expectations: Shows the same starter menu as start ThreadWave
Runs only the fixed tw credits --format json lookup
Does not classify tw followed by a subcommand as the starter alias
